summary.text: Deb Fellela is a Democratic state representative from District 43 who took office in 2007 and is seeking re-election; she advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her as the House deputy majority leader.

paragraphs.text: Fellela's career included work as a secretary and principal at R.F. Kennedy School and as an employee of John Hancock Insurance, according to Ballotpedia.
She attended East Providence High School.
